notes.body:
Canagliflozin body model
Distribution of canagliflozin and its glucuronides M5 and M7 with the blood flow, the tissue distribution of canagliflozin, the hepatic and renal metabolism, the biliary excretion of the metabolites with the hydrolysis of the glucuronides in the intestine, and the renal excretion.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

Fasting plasma glucose (FPG), set by the studies. It shifts the RTG (SGLT2 is induced in type 2 diabetes) and, with the difference of the mean plasma glucose of the day to the FPG (PG_delta), gives the glucose which is filtered.

parameter.name: Cumulative dose due to infusion can

blockquote.p: 1.0: increased kidney function 1.0: normal kidney function (healthy control) <1.0: decreased kidney function

body.p: Renal function relative to the healthy glomerular filtration rate GFR_base, which is 101 ml/min at 75 kg; a measured creatinine clearance or GFR of X ml/min is the renal function X/101. It scales the filtration (renal excretion, glucose excretion) and the renal glucuronidation (the functional renal mass).

parameter.name: scaling factor renal anion transport of the glucuronides

body.p: Scaling factor of the renal clearance of the glucuronides M5 and M7, which are secreted by the organic anion transporters (OAT1/OAT3) of the proximal tubule. Probenecid, an inhibitor of OAT1/OAT3, lowers the renal clearance of M5 by 82 % and of M7 by 58 % [Devineni2015d]. 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 inhibited.
Canagliflozin is 99 % bound to plasma proteins, mainly albumin, independent of the renal and hepatic function [Devineni2015c, Devineni2015b].

parameter.name: renal clearance of unbound canagliflozin relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of canagliflozin is CANEX_f times the filtration of its unbound fraction, fu_can * GFR: 1 is filtration alone. The renal clearance of 0.8-1.4 ml/min [Chen2015, Inagaki2014, Devineni2015d] is about the filtration of the unbound fraction.
The value of KI__CANEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261019_103422__858e3, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: The renal clearance of M5 is M5EX_f times the GFR, 1.87 l/hr (31 ml/min) [Devineni2015d].
The value of KI__M5EX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261019_103422__858e3, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the renal glucuronidation of canagliflozin to M7 (UGT1A9)

body.p: First-order rate of the renal UGT1A9, relative to the volume of the kidney: canagliflozin is far below the Km of UGT1A9, its pharmacokinetics are dose proportional from 50 to 300 mg [Devineni2015e]. The renal share of the clearance is identified by the exposure in renal impairment [Devineni2015c].

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day minus the fasting plasma glucose

body.p: The glucose which is filtered over the day is the mean plasma glucose of the day, above the fasting plasma glucose by the meals. In healthy subjects about 0.85 mM: the urinary glucose excretion of 285 mmol/day over a GFR of 139 l/day with a 24-hr mean RTG of 3.79 mM is a mean plasma glucose of 5.85 mM [Sha2015]. Studies which report the 24-hr mean plasma glucose set the difference to the FPG.
EC50 of the reduction of the RTG by plasma canagliflozin (total), 32 ng/ml (95 % CI 19-45 ng/ml) = 7.2e-5 mM [Devineni2013]; the fitted value is 34 ng/ml (fit PD_20261019_201254__61546).
The value of KI__RTG_E50 is the result of the fit PD_20261019_201254__61546, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: splay of the glucose excretion around the RTG

body.p: The thresholds of the nephrons differ, so the glucose excretion rises smoothly around the RTG (splay) instead of at a sharp threshold; the softplus with a width of 1 mM.

parameter.name: integral of the RTG over the collection interval

body.p: Reset to 0 with RTG_time at the start of a collection interval of the urine, see RTG_mean.

parameter.name: duration of the collection interval of the RTG

body.p: Reset to 0 with RTG_int at the start of a collection interval of the urine, see RTG_mean.

mean RTG of the collection interval

Scaling factor of the CYP3A4 activity. 1.0: unchanged activity; < 1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.

body.p: Fast exchange: the uptake does not limit the metabolism, which is limited by the hepatic blood flow and the enzymes.

parameter.name: rate of the M5 exchange of the liver

body.p: Fast exchange of the glucuronide between the liver and the plasma (efflux by MRP3, uptake by OATP1B), so that the glucuronide of the plasma is excreted into the bile as well.

parameter.name: rate of the M7 exchange of the liver

body.p: Fast exchange of the glucuronide between the liver and the plasma, see M5EX_k.

parameter.name: rate of the biliary excretion of M5

body.p: The non-renal elimination of the glucuronide: the exposure of M5 increases only 2.4-3.0 fold in severe renal impairment and end stage renal disease [Devineni2015c].
The value of LI__M5BIEX_k is the result of the fit PK_20261019_103422__858e3, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the fecal excretion of the metabolites

body.p: Transit of the metabolites of the bile through the intestine into the feces (half-life of about 12 hr); M5 is hydrolysed in the feces and excreted as canagliflozin.

assignmentRule.name: sum of canagliflozin, M5 and M7 (plasma)

body.p: log(2) ~ 0.693 used for conversion of half-life injection time to injection rate.

assignmentRule.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

body.p: The glucose which is filtered.
FPG dependent RTG without SGLT2 inhibition. SGLT2 is induced in T2DM [Rahmoune2005].
Renal threshold glucose.

The renal threshold for glucose (RTG) is the plasma glucose concentration at which the tubular reabsorption of glucose begins to saturate; glucose is excreted into the urine in proportion to the glucose concentration above this threshold. 12.3 - 12.7 mM RTG (placebo, T2DM) [Devineni2012]

assignmentRule.name: mean RTG of the collection interval

body.p: The studies report the RTG of a collection interval of the urine (the 24-hr mean RTG or the RTG of the intervals of the day), the mean of the RTG since the last reset of RTG_int and RTG_time.
Urinary glucose excretion, the cumulative amount of glucose in the urine.
The glucuronidation of the canagliflozin of the renal plasma; the uptake into the tubular cells and the export of M7 are fast.
The filtered glucose above the RTG, the softplus of the difference with the width RTG_splay: the excretion approaches GFR * (pg - RTG) above the RTG and zero below it.

reaction.name: M5 bile flow into the intestine
M7 bile flow into the intestine
M9 bile flow into the intestine
M5 excretion (M5EXC, feces, hydrolysed to canagliflozin)

body.p: Swallowing, dissolution of tablet, and transport into intestine. Overall process describing the rates of this processes.
